decisionsTitle: Race results, part 1: entered or imported by race number, ranked, published only when the notice says so
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-17 (~08:20):** «Aș vrea să pot pune și clasament la final după cursă». Results were on the deferred list since §11 and `BUSINESS.md` §8 («timing, results, bibs, check-in»); the bibs and the check-in exist since (`registrations.bib_number`, `checked_in_at`, the desk §67), the registration's tick already says «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» (§143, §102, §570) and the Excel's «Statistici» define the categories (§787). This decides §11.3's open proposal for **one distance per race**; §11.1 (several distances in one race) stays deferred.

**Decision, the data.** One table, `event_results` (migration `0166`, an expand: a new table and two columns with a default), a row per **race number**: the registration it belongs to (`ON DELETE SET NULL`), a name, a sex and a birth date only for a runner the club typed by hand, the state (`FINISHED`, `DNF`, `DNS`, `DSQ`), the gun time and the chip time in milliseconds, a note of up to 200 characters, the three positions and the category key, who changed it and when. The database holds the rules a save also asserts: a finisher has a time and the others have none, only a finisher is placed, one row per number and per registration. `events.results_published` (false by default) and `results_published_at`; a duplicate, a repeat and the JSON file never carry them. A registered runner's name, sex and birth date are **never copied**: they are read from the registration, so a correction there is the correction here. Erasing a registration leaves its result, nameless and with its place, so no other runner's position moves under it.

**The service** (`modules/results/`, the rules pure in `domain/`). `saveEventResults` writes the **whole list in one transaction**: every row is read first and the first refused row refuses everything, naming the runner and the box (§791's pattern); a number named twice, a finisher with no time, a time beside abandon / neprezentat / descalificat, a runner with no registration and no name (a row already stored with none — an erased registration's — may stay nameless), a bad sex or birth date, a note over 200 characters. A row with every box empty is no result; a time typed with no status is `FINISHED`, a note alone is `DNS`; a row left out of the list is a result removed. Only the rows that changed are written, one audit row each (`event_result.created`, `.updated`, `.deleted`: the number, the state, the times and the names of the boxes that changed — **never a name, a sex, a birth date or a note**), and the positions of the other rows are rewritten silently. A form drawn before another session saved is refused with CONFLICT (a fingerprint of the stored rows, posted back; §36's rule). The public cache is told once, after the commit. `deleteEventResult` is the row's own confirmed press (§384, §791).

**The rankings** are computed on save and stored: overall among the finishers by gun time, by sex, and by category — the **sex and the band of the age on the event's day, exactly the Excel footer's** (`statistics.ts`: `categoryKeyOf` is the one definition, `STATISTICS_AGE_BANDS` the one table; no second band table). Ties share the place and the next is skipped (1, 2, 2, 4). A runner who did not finish has no place; one without a sex or a birth date has no category, and nobody is guessed into one. The gun time ranks; the chip time is shown.

**The import** is `bib,time[,chip][,status]`, with a header (Romanian or English names, any order) or without, separated by a comma, a semicolon or a tab, the status as its code or its word in either language, the times in the boxes' own shapes. `importResultsCsv` **writes nothing**: it matches each number to the event's registrations (any state, never a test row) and the action answers with the table's boxes filled — a returned state, not a redirect — and a notice that says nothing is saved yet; a number no registration holds becomes a new typed line with the name left to write. The first bad line refuses the file, naming it.

**Who.** The Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator enter, import, delete and download (`canEnterResults` = `canReadRegistrations`: a result changes no registration and reads the names the Organizer already reads); **only the Administrator and the Superadministrator publish** (`canPublishResults`). The Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member are refused by the service, the actions and the route, whatever the page drew (BR-REQ-060-01). Only a race takes results; the page says a group run has none.

**The page** is `/admin/events/[id]/results`, linked from the event editor's «Înscrieri» card and the registrations list's header for a race that has started: ONE «Salvează tot clasamentul» (the second button of the same form, «Importă din CSV», only fills the boxes; Enter saves), a line for every registered runner who holds a number — checked-in first — with «Timp», «Status», «Timp cip» and «Notă», the places a save gave, a card for the typed runners, each line's «Șterge» as the page's one hidden form (`form=` and the number as the button's own value), «Descarcă clasamentul (CSV)» (the backoffice sees every name; the download is audited with a count). The boxes are native inputs on purpose: a race has hundreds of lines.

**The name rule extends the public list's (§143, §396).** The public read (`readPublicEventResults`, for the page lane) shows a name **only for a registered runner whose list tick is on** — the same tick, withdrawn the same way — and otherwise «Participant #bib»; a runner the club typed by hand is never named in public, because no staff member may tick for a runner. It returns nothing unless the Administrator published, the notice in force describes the results and the public list's period (§421) has not passed; no row carries an address, a phone number, a document, a note or a registration's id.

**The notice gate, §396's pattern.** The privacy notice's template replaces «Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă» with two paragraphs in section 4 and the merge field `{{results}}` (the public section's own name, quoted): what the ranking shows, whose name, that it closes with the public list, where the data stays. `describesResults` / `noticeDescribesResults` / `cachedResultsDescribed` read it; `setResultsPublished` refuses ON with `RESULTS_NOTICE` while the notice in force does not name it in **both** languages (OFF is never refused); `/admin/tasks` carries the row `resultsNotice` (open, never blocking, done by itself); `/admin/legal` says so in a line. The terms' template sentence («Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă; când o vom face, te vom întreba separat») changed with it, since the tick is that ask. The publish tick is its own form (a real tick box with its own «Salvează», asking first both ways), not a toggle button.

**Retention.** The sweep clears, three years after the race with the registrations, the typed names, sexes, birth dates and every note (`event-results-names`); the rows, times and places stay.

**Amends** §143 and §396 (the public name rule reaches the results, and §396's notice-gate pattern is the one used), §787 (the categories are reused, not redefined), and BR-REQ-072-01's «Given M1» criteria 5 and 6 (results now exist; the consent is the list tick).

**Refused.** A second band table; ranking by chip time; copying a registered runner's name into the result; a name for a typed runner on the public page (no staff-given consent); publishing before the notice describes the results; a toggle button for the publish switch; one save per row; MUI text fields for hundreds of lines; touching the allocator, the registrations' states, the desk or the Excel. **Left for the owner and the lawyer:** whether registrants under an earlier notice need §421's per-registration rule for results; «Toate datele unei persoane» does not list a person's result yet; a participant's own «Rezultatul tău» email. A results requirement `BR-REQ-07x` is for the dispatcher to open: the criteria below sit under the existing requirements they extend.
changelogLine: - **«Clasament» for a race, in the backoffice** — times typed or imported from a CSV by race number, ranked overall, by sex and by category, one «Salvează tot clasamentul»; made public by an Administrator only once the privacy notice describes the results (a new section 4 paragraph and a row on «Sarcini»), with a name only for those who ticked the list. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a race whose results an Administrator made public under a privacy notice that names `{{results}}`, when the public read returns them, then a name is shown only for a registered runner whose «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» tick is on (withdrawing it takes the name off the next read) and everyone else is «Participant #bib»; a runner the club typed by hand is never named; nothing is returned unless the results are published, the notice in force describes them and the public list's period has not passed; and no row carries an address, a phone number, a document, a note or a registration's id (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/results.test.ts`, privacy `public-surface.test.ts`.

Given a race that has started, when an Organizer or an Administrator opens `/admin/events/[id]/results` («Clasament») and presses «Salvează tot clasamentul», then every line is saved in one transaction or, when one line is refused, none — the sentence naming the runner and the box, every box keeping what was typed; a form older than another session's save is refused with CONFLICT; only changed rows are written, each with one audit row that names the race number, the state and the times and never a name; and the overall, by-sex and by-category positions are stored (the Excel footer's own bands, ties sharing a place and the next skipped, a runner without a sex or a birth date having no category) (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/results.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`, `results/page.test.ts`, e2e `race-results.spec.ts`.

Given a CSV `bib,time[,chip][,status]` pasted or chosen on «Clasament», when «Importă din CSV» is pressed, then nothing is saved: the file's times fill the boxes of the lines they belong to, a number no registration holds becomes a new typed line with the name left to write, a bad line refuses the file naming it, and a row's «Șterge» is its own confirmed press that recomputes the others' places (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/import-csv.test.ts`, `results/rows-and-merge.test.ts`, integration `results/actions.test.ts`.

Given the privacy notice in force, when an Administrator ticks «Clasamentul e public pe pagina evenimentului», then the tick is refused with a sentence and a link to «Documente legale» unless the notice in force names `{{results}}` in both languages (the platform's template does, replacing «Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă»); taking the results off is never refused; `/admin/tasks` carries the row `resultsNotice` until such a notice is in force (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/results.test.ts`, unit `results/notice.test.ts`, `diagnostics/owner-tasks.test.ts`.

Given a race's results, when the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer or a member enters, reads, imports, deletes or downloads them, or the Organizer makes them public, then the service, the action and the route refuse it with FORBIDDEN whatever the page drew; only the Organizer and the Administrators enter, and only the Administrators publish (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/results.test.ts`, unit `staff/roles.test.ts`.

Amends criteria 5 and 6 («Given M1»): results now exist for a race, and the consent they publish under is the registration's own list tick, one tick for the list and the results — no second box is asked and no staff member ticks it for a runner (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: race results, part 1: entered or imported by bib in the backoffice, ranked overall, by sex and by category, published only when the notice says so
